Built's Mission:
Connect and simplify doing business in real estate.

Built is the AI-powered platform transforming the way real estate is financed, developed, and managed. Purpose-built for real estate and construction, Built began by fixing construction draw management for lenders and has grown into a comprehensive operating system addressing some of the industry’s most complex challenges. Today, Built is a partner to more than 350 lenders, over 80,000 borrowers and owners, and thousands of contractors, powering 86,000 active projects valued at more than $300 billion. Learn more at getbuilt.com
.

__________________________

Built is transforming how capital moves through construction and real estate finance — one of the largest, most complex sectors in the economy. Our platform connects lenders, including many of the top U.S. banks, with the owners, developers, and general contractors they finance. When a draw is approved, a builder can pay subcontractors. When a compliance document clears, a project moves forward. The work we do here is not abstract — it has a direct and material impact on how capital flows and how real estate gets built.

Our Implementations team is responsible for turning Built's platform into operational reality for lenders, developers, and contractors across the country. As a Senior Implementation Consultant
, you will own Built's most complex and strategic implementation relationships, setting the standard for delivery excellence across the organization. You work independently with periodic guidance, are recognized as the go-to resource for the hardest implementation challenges, and informally raise the capability of those around you through the standards you set and the expertise you share.

Our Guiding Principles

Be Bold. We pursue the biggest problems in our industry, challenge assumptions others take for granted, and take calculated risks to get there. We don't hide behind consensus or committees. Playing it safe is just failing slowly.
Help Customers Win. We learn our customers' businesses deeply — how they think, how they deploy capital, what keeps them up at night. We treat their capital like our own. We ship leverage, not features. And we measure ourselves by customer results, not our intentions.
Move with Urgency & Purpose. We bias toward delivery over perfection, remove friction from our own paths, and communicate in real time. Momentum compounds — and we build it every day.
Own the Outcome. We own outcomes, not just tasks. We hold a high Say:Do ratio and take responsibility from idea through impact. When something breaks, we fix it — we don't wait to be asked.
Never Satisfied. We raise the bar continuously. We stay curious, hold exacting standards, debate hard, and hold our opinions loosely when the evidence shifts. Excellence is a habit, not an event.

What You'll Do

Own the largest and most complex client implementations independently — driving success across technical, organizational, and commercial dimensions from kickoff through stabilization.
Serve as a strategic advisor to clients on organizational change, training strategy, and platform adoption; guide clients through transformational implementations with authority and care.
Design and implement standardized methodologies, templates, and playbooks that improve delivery speed and consistency across all implementations in the function.
Lead cross-functional workstreams with Product, Engineering, and Solutions Consulting to solve novel implementation challenges and expand Built's service capabilities.
Serve as an escalation point for high-risk or high-impact projects — diagnosing root causes, driving resolution, and ensuring the client relationship remains intact.
Identify and own key performance metrics for implementation health; use data to drive decisions that optimize efficiency and client satisfaction across the portfolio.
Informally mentor implementation managers — share expertise, provide guidance on complex client situations, and help raise the standard for delivery across the team.
Champion AI and tooling adoption within the implementations function; model how technology accelerates delivery quality and client outcomes.

What You'll Bring

4–7 years of experience in SaaS implementation, professional services, or enterprise project delivery, with demonstrated ownership of the most complex client engagements in your portfolio.
Deep expertise in enterprise implementation strategy, change management, and organizational transformation — you've guided clients through hard changes and made them stick.
A strong track record of designing processes or frameworks that measurably improved delivery speed, consistency, or client satisfaction across a team.
The ability to influence senior client stakeholders and navigate complex, politically sensitive organizational dynamics with confidence and professionalism.
Deep familiarity with construction finance and lending workflows — draw management, lien waivers, compliance tracking, loan administration, regulatory requirements — and the ability to credibly advise clients on how Built fits their business.
Experience with enterprise software implementation methodologies and comfort adapting your approach to the complexity and culture of each client environment.
A subject matter expert orientation — you share what you know, hold high standards, and leave the function's methodology better than you found it.

What Success Looks Like At Six Months

Your implementations are consistently recognized as the most successful in the portfolio — clients achieve adoption outcomes faster, escalations are rare, and satisfaction scores reflect your standard.
At least one playbook, methodology, or framework you developed has been adopted broadly across the implementations function and is producing measurable improvements.
The escalations that land on your desk get resolved cleanly — root causes are identified, client relationships are preserved, and the team learns something from each one.
Implementation managers across the team seek your input on complex client situations before they escalate — your judgment and domain expertise are widely trusted.
Cross-functional partners in Product, Engineering, and Sales view you as a strategic thought partner on implementation strategy, not just a delivery resource.

AI & Technology Expectations

Leverage AI tools to enhance the productivity, quality, and speed of your work.
Use AI to support drafting, analysis, summarization, and problem-solving across your role.
Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and reduce manual effort through automation and AI.
Apply AI to sharpen decision-making and strengthen strategic insights.
Share effective AI use cases and best practices with your team.

Built’s salary range for this position is $125,000 - 163,000 USD per year. The pay range is designed to accommodate upward mobility in the role, therefore it encompasses the full span of proficiency levels for this role and we believe that the midpoint of the range is competitive in the market. Salary is just one component of Built's total compensation package for employees; your total rewards package at Built will include equity, market-current medical, dental and vision coverage, an unlimited PTO policy, and other benefits.
